{{Quote|What was first just a dream has become a frightening reality for those who may oppose us.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Part Six" />}}
'''Thrawn's forces'''<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> were initially the gathered members and equipment of a small [[Imperial Remnants|Imperial Remnant]] commanded by the [[Chiss]] [[warlord]] [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "Thrawn" during the [[New Republic Era]]. Thrawn commanded his forces from his [[flagship]], the ''[[Chimaera]],'' during their [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] in a [[far galaxy]]. The ground forces consisted of<ref name="Part Six" /> a [[Thrawn's Night Trooper legion|legion]] of<ref name="This Week" /> [[Night Trooper]]s under [[Captain of the Guard]] [[Enoch]]. As a [[fleet]], the [[Chiss]] [[commander]] possessed the damaged [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|ISD]] ''Chimaera'' and its complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]]s and [[LAAT/le patrol gunship]]s. Admiral Thrawn's forces were allied with the [[Great Mothers]], who also sought to escape from exile on [[Peridea]].<ref name="Part Six" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> upon their arrival to deliver Thrawn and the Great Mothers from exile, the [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|forces]] of his old ally [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] survivor [[Lady]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] became part of his.<ref name="Part Seven" />

Upon Thrawn's return to [[the galaxy]], his forces encompassed the military assets he used in his [[Campaign against Thrawn's forces|war]] with the [[New Republic]]. Ultimately the New Republic won it like they did with the [[Galactic Civil War]], defeating the [[Imperial Remnant/Canon|Imperial Remnant]] in the process.<ref name="Rise and Fall" />

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Thrawn's forces first appeared in "[[Part Six: Far, Far Away]]"<ref name="Part Six" /> and were identified as such by an art print by artist [[Joe Hogan]].<ref name="Thrawn's forces">{{Acme|url=products/thrawns-forces-joe-hogan|text=Thrawn's Forces by Joe Hogan}}</ref> The capitalization of "forces," however, was not clarified until the release of ''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''.<ref name="Rise and Fall" />
